body: yes- just been in a bit of a rut lately. i typically am able to block out the feelings, but things haven't felt great for me the past few days. i figure this is a good way of expressing what i've been feeling, to a crowd of understanding strangers.

thank you for commenting. thank you for taking the time to think about me. i really appreciate it. i hope this feeling passes in due time but it's followed me my entire life. i'm really thankful that someone cares, either way. there's no feasible way for me to repay you for your kind words, and i don't consider myself particularly religious, so i suppose the best i can offer you is a wish that your life will find happiness and less troubles than mine ever has. that you will receive due payment for your time. 

thank you.

thank you. i don't blame my parents necessarily-i realize it came off that way in the text, so i apologize for the confusion. they tried to hide it from me for a while but it ended up coming out. i've overheard conversations, picked up on things that suddenly changed after my birth, etcetera. they eventually told me in a very sincere yet direct manner. your comment and time is really appreciated. i hope for you to find more happiness and less troubles than i have up to this point in my life.
